title: Tender Italian Meatball Stew
description: Hearty Italian-style stew with tender meatballs and rich flavors.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine breadcrumbs, beef mincemeat, italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes or until cooked through.
In a large Dutch oven or saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the stew, then add the cooked meatballs to the pot.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 10-15 minutes or until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
